ansible-galaxy.description: Manage pins in both requirements files. The built-in manager only matches requirements.yml by default; the extra pattern brings requirements-dev.yml in too. See CLAUDE.md's 'Dependency updates' section.

packageRules.description: Disable Renovate's github-actions manager for python in tests.yml; the python/bash jobs' 3.9 pin is frozen. See CLAUDE.md's 'Python 3.9 pin' section.

Keep the cross-repo commit-file-via-app action floating on @main; helpers:pinGitHubActionDigestsToSemver would otherwise SHA-pin it. Deliberate — see CLAUDE.md's 'Devcontainer lock regeneration' section.

Join digest updates on deliberately-floating base image tags to the non-major batch. On a floating tag a moving digest IS the routine update mechanism, not a re-tag, so the solo-PR treatment digests get by default would be pure noise. Immutable version tags keep that default. See CLAUDE.md's 'Base image pins' section.
Batch every non-major update into a single PR. Grouped by update type, not by manager. Must stay last. See CLAUDE.md's 'Dependency updates' section.

customManagers.description: Track the molecule scenarios' base image. molecule.yml is not a file any built-in manager parses, so without this the pinned digest would never be refreshed and the scenarios would silently rot on a fixed image. versioningTemplate is docker (NOT the customManager default semver-coerced) — the `latest` tag can't be coerced to semver, which silently suppresses the digest update. See CLAUDE.md's 'Base image pins' section.
Keep the devcontainer's tooling-Python pin (`tooling_python` in post-create.sh) current. Only the annotated assignment is matched, so the frozen 3.9.6 in the same file is never touched.
Keep the molecule CI job's Python pin (`python-version` under setup-python) current — should track the devcontainer's `tooling_python` (post-create.sh) so local dev and CI agree on the interpreter.

Keep tests/run's shebang Python pin current — should track `tooling_python` (post-create.sh) and the molecule CI job's `python-version` (tests.yml) so the dev tooling, local lint, and CI all run under the same interpreter.
